high_level_description: A single full-body woman in a floral sundress and straw hat, bending slightly, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and grassy ground below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale sky (#E6F7FF) occupying upper ~87% of canvas (y=0 to y=780), grassy ground (#C8E6C9) as horizontal band from y=780 to y=900

elements.desc: head: light yellow circle, centered at (800,220), radius 100
torso: light pink rounded rectangle, vertical, slightly tilted left 15 degrees
left arm: thin vertical light pink rectangle, slightly forward
right arm: thin vertical light pink rectangle, slightly forward and mirrored
left leg: light pink tapered rectangle, knee bent slightly
right leg: light pink tapered rectangle, knee bent slightly
straw hat brim: light yellow ellipse, centered at (800,240), width 160, height 40
straw hat crown: light yellow circle, centered at (800,190), radius 30
floral sundress: light pink trapezoid, wider at hem, with 7 small colored flowers scattered across front
